{{Quote|The Old Republic was the Republic of legend, greater than distance or time. No need to note where it was or whence it came, only to know that&hellip; it was ''the'' Republic.|From the [[Journal of the Whills/Legends|Journal of the Whills]]|<ref name="ANHNovel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>}}
The '''Galactic Republic''' ([[25,053 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] 16:5:23) was the ruling government of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that existed for more than twenty-five thousand years, until its reformation into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in 19 BBY. Throughout its existence, the state was commonly known as the '''Republic'''. In the [[Imperial Era/Legends|post-Republic era]] and [[Rebellion era|beyond]], it was remembered as the '''Old Republic'''; it was also rarely known as the '''Old Galactic Republic''' or the '''First Galactic Republic'''. At times, the [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#O|term]] '''Old Order''' was used to describe the Republic but was not common.

The Galactic Republic was a representative democracy, composed of various [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and member [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] throughout most of the known galaxy. Its central government consisted of three branches: legislative, executive and judicial. The first was the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], a [[Organization|body]] of elected or appointed [[Senator/Legends|representatives]]. Its main duties included mediating disputes over issues ranging from planetary to galactic-scale, regulating trade routes between star systems, and in theory, represented the interests of Republic citizens. The [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] was the Senate's executive counterpart. The [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] was elected from the ranks of the Senate by its members. As the leader of the Senate and the overall representative of the Republic, the Chancellor also held the titles [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|President]]. The judicial branch consisted of the [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]] and the lower [[Regional Court]]s. The Supreme Court was composed of twelve [[Judge/Legends|justices]], one of whom held the leadership position of [[Chief Justice]].

Throughout most of its history as the dominant galactic power, the Republic did not style itself as a strong centralized government, but rather as a union of sovereign planets for the purposes of collective security and economic prosperity. It was said that its complete history could "fill a thousand libraries." In the [[Rise of the Empire era|last decades]] that preceded the rise of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Republic was a benevolent&mdash;though ineffectual&mdash;government tied up in layers of bureaucracy, hampered by political and corporate corruption. The Galactic Republic, which had existed for at least 25,034 years, was brought down by the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] when they [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] it into the Galactic Empire. This, however, was just the first [[New Republic/Legends|of]] [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|seven]] [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|regime]] [[Fel Empire|changes]] [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|that]] [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate|replaced]] the Old Republic over the next 157 years.

==History==

=== Origins ===
Millennia prior to the founding of the Galactic Republic, the galaxy was dominated by the Infinite Empire. Utilizing advanced Force-based technologies, the Rakata subjugated numerous systems, including the Human-populated Core Worlds of Coruscant and Corellia. Rakatan rule over these regions endured for centuries.<ref name="TORE" />

The empire’s decline resulted from a combination of [[Rakatan Civil War|internal conflict]] and a species-specific genetic [[Rakatan plague|plague]] that severely reduced the Rakatan population and disrupted their connection to the Force, rendering much of their technology inoperable. As central authority weakened, subject populations initiated widespread slave uprisings, ultimately forcing the Rakata into retreat.<ref name="TORE" />

In the resulting power vacuum, Coruscant developed into a center of industrial reconstruction and planetary defense, driven in part by concerns over a potential Rakatan return. In the centuries that followed, after rebuilding their worlds, the liberated Core Worlds formed cooperative alliances and expanded into neighboring systems. The experience of subjugation significantly influenced the political foundations of the Galactic Republic, which later emerged from this union of the Core Worlds.<ref name="TORE" />

===Formation===
{{Quote|For over a thousand generations, the Jedi Knights were the guardians of peace and justice in the Old Republic. Before the dark times. Before the Empire.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="EpisodeIV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Atlas_pre-republic.jpg|thumb|left|The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] around which the Republic was formed]]
The Republic was born with the ratification of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] in [[25,053 BBY]], during the [[Unification Wars (Galactic Republic)|Unification Wars]]. During that time [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] reverse-engineered [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]-based [[Force-drive|technologies]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] to create the first [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], allowing [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to become the capital of the Galactic Republic [[25,000 BBY/Legends|53 years later]] and would remain that way for twenty-five thousand years. The founding members of the government, largely [[Core Founder/Legends|Humans from the Core Worlds]] were protected from outside influence by the clandestine group known as the [[GenoHaradan]], an organization which wished to see the government flourish and whose existence was unknown to the galactic populace, even the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

Shortly after the formation of the Republic, the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] was mapped, linking Coruscant to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], and bringing the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] into the Republic. A key world of this route was [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] which was the source of the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic credit]] that traded with the native [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who controlled the newly formed [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Over the next millennia, the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] was mapped, linking Coruscant to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and beyond. The wedge defined by the two trade routes became known as "[[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]." Since the stretch of hyperspace galactic-west of Coruscant was [[Hyperspace anomaly/Legends|anomaly]]-ridden and impassable for the current Republic technology, the government expanded eastward instead. The [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] portion of the Slice was known as the [[Arrowhead]], and soon the Republic expanded into the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

Though history often recalls the Republic as peaceful, numerous galactic conflicts, such as the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], the [[Old Sith Wars]], the [[Vultar Cataclysm]], the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[New Sith Wars]], and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], occurred throughout its existence.

===Early history===
[[File:Uglykotoricon.svg|thumb|130px|The former symbol of the Republic, before being replaced with later symbols.]]
At first, the government on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] wished for slow expansion, despite its promotion of hyperspace exploration. However, against the government's wishes, the membership of the Republic boomed for its first millennium of existence, mainly due to worlds wishing to join as protection against the [[Hutt Empire]]. In [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] its capital had officially become a galactic hub, by then the Hutt Empire had fallen and became [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

For years, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and the ancient armies and navies of the Republic defended against violence. Around [[24,500 BBY]], the [[First Great Schism]] occurred, after the [[Legions of Lettow]] were established by dissident Jedi who believed that true power was achieved not through passive meditation, as taught by their [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], but through emotion. The tension between the Jedi and these dissident Fallen Jedi led first by [[Xendor]], and then after Xendor's death, by [[Arden Lyn]], grew until conflict erupted.

In [[24,000 BBY]], the Republic entered into the [[Tionese War]] against the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]]. The war traveled up and down the Perlemian, and the respective capitals of Coruscant and [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] both suffered volleys of [[pressure bomb]]s. The Republic eventually won the war by stirring up the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] against the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]]. Within a century, most of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] swore allegiance to Coruscant, except for Desevro, which chose to remain independent.
[[File:Atlas_early_republic.jpg|thumb|left|The early Republic around [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].]]
During the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] ([[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000]] &ndash; [[17,000 BBY]]), the Republic expanded eastwards across the galaxy. Despite this, the Slice would remain the heart of navigable space. Eventually, the Republic expanded past the galactic-northern and -southern borders of the Slice, though most of the galaxy was still unknown, except for outposts such as [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] ([[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]) and [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] ([[8000 BBY]]). The space west of Coruscant still remained unexplored since analogs to the Perlemian Trade Route and the Corellian Run in that direction still had not been discovered. Worse, progress was limited to dangerous one- or two-light-year jumps into a stretch of hyperspatial anomalies. During this period, the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] was formed. However, this region suffered greatly as a result of the [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] attempting to snatch control of the Republic from Coruscant. This resulted in seventeen [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], spanning from 17,000 BBY to [[3000 BBY]]. However, most of the fighting took place between their holdings in the Expansion Region, rather than in the Core itself. For the most part, Coruscant won every conflict it fought, though the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict|seventh one]] was a notable exception.

During this period, the [[First Arkanian Conflict]] also took place. The [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] geneticists also began a series of genetic experiments of other sentient species, most notably bundling away several six-armed [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] from [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]], and transforming them into a new species known as the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermians]].

In [[15,500 BBY]], after a disastrous first contact, Coruscant was assaulted by [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Star Dragons]] in the [[Duinuogwuin Contention]]. The conflict was peacefully resolved by Supreme Chancellor [[Fillorean]] and the Star Dragon philosopher [[Borz'Mat'oh]], who together founded the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]]. At some time before 12,000 BBY, the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] was established on Coruscant.

[[File:SenateHall-TGAotS4.jpg|thumb|300px|The [[Senate Hall]].]]
Around 12,000 BBY, [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]] became Supreme Chancellor. He and his descendants belonged to the theocratic ''[[Pius Dea]]'' cult that would control the Republic for the next 1,000 years. These fanatic Supreme Chancellors sanctioned "[[Pius Dea Crusades|crusades]]" against rival alien sects in the Rim. After [[11,000 BBY]] the cult may have violently dissolved. The tensions from the fallout of the crusades would deepen the rifts between the Core Worlds and those of the Rim, which Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] would exploit during his reign millennia later.

Around [[9000 BBY]], [[Blotus]] the Hutt became Supreme Chancellor and ruled the Galactic Republic for 275 years during the [[Rianitus Period]]. Unlike most other Hutts, Blotus was a distinguished and just ruler. At least by [[7308 BBY]], the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]] was fixed.

In [[7003 BBY]], the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Second Great Schism]] occurred when a group of fallen Jedi discovered a Force technique that could alter lifeforms. This started the centuries-long Hundred-Year Darkness, which saw the creation of monstrous creatures, most notably the serpentine [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]], which drew life-energies into blister-traps on their backs. At the [[Battle of Corbos]] in [[6900 BBY]], the Jedi crushed the rebellion and banished these [[Exiles|fallen Jedi]] from known space. However, the fallen Jedi discovered [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], a desolate world inhabited by the relatively primitive but unusually Force-sensitive [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] people.

Using their training in the Force, the fallen Jedi amazed the Sith and elevated themselves to god-like status on nearby [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], becoming the rulers of the Sith people. As years passed, and interbreeding occurred between the fallen Jedi and the Sith, the term "Sith" came to mean not only the original inhabitants of Korriban and Ziost but also their fallen Jedi masters.
[[File:CoruscantGreatHyperspaceWar-JediVsSith.jpg|thumb|left|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Galactic capital, assaulted during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].]]
In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the Jedi and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]] clashed in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Many worlds were forever scarred in that battle, but the Jedi were able to repulse the invaders. After that, the Republic granted the Jedi land over a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]]: a sacred mountain on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] over which the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was constructed. The Sith were defeated in that same year but not destroyed.

In [[4250 BBY]], the [[Third Great Schism]] occurred, which involved fighting on Coruscant. The surviving Dark Jedi were forced to flee to the [[Vultar system/Legends|Vultar system]], where they discovered ancient technology indicating that the system's worlds were artificial constructs, probably the creations of the mysterious [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] who had also built the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. These Dark Jedi took over these machines, including the [[Cosmic Turbine]], but could not control them, and soon destroyed the whole system and everything in them during the Vultar Cataclysm. Around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], four Jedi Masters (two [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Warrior Masters]] and two [[Jedi Consular|Sage Masters]]) established the ziggurat of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] over the Force nexus on Coruscant, which would stand for over four thousand years.

===Old Sith Wars===
{{Main|Old Sith Wars}}

{{Quote|The Republic is a stagnant beast that had been killing its people for years before the war began.|[[Canderous Ordo]], referring to the [[Mandalorian Wars]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
The year [[4015 BBY]] saw the [[Great Droid Revolution]] on Coruscant, led by [[HK-01]], who was eventually defeated by [[Arca Jeth]] and the Jedi. During the conflict, Arca Jeth discovered techniques for disabling machines through the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

Following those conflicts were those of the [[Old Sith Wars]], that began of c.[[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] which almost destroyed the Republic. During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] (4000 BBY&ndash;[[3996 BBY]]), the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] and [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], along with their [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] allies, waged war on the Republic with their own Sith Empire, causing devastation until they were defeated by the combined Jedi and Republic forces. Afterward, the [[Cleansing of the Nine Houses]] and subsequently the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]] occurred ([[3995 BBY|3995]]&ndash;[[3993 BBY]]). 

After the end of the Great Sith War, the Galactic Republic entered the [[Restoration Period]] (3995–[[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]]). The devastation caused by the conflict left many worlds ruined, trade routes disrupted, and entire sectors cut off from communications. Economic depression and widespread piracy forced the Senate to introduce financial and military reforms to stabilize the Republic, restore hyperspace commerce, and rebuild the Republic Navy.<ref>''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
[[File:Battle_of_Vanquo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Republic and Mandalorian fleets clash at the [[Battle of Vanquo]].]]
These would be followed by the [[Mandalorian Wars]] ([[3976 BBY|3976]]&mdash;[[3960 BBY]]). They were fought between Mandalorian forces hoping to expand their colonies beyond the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the Galactic Republic, which feared further incursions. The Mandalorian Wars were a prelude to the more devastating [[Jedi Civil War]] ([[3959 BBY|3959]]&ndash;[[3956 BBY]]). The Jedi Civil War, also known to some as the War of the Star Forge, was fought between the Republic and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] under [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]]. It was possibly the most destructive conflict of that entire era, with many worlds, including [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and [[Telos IV]], being devastated by the Sith fleet. After the Jedi Civil War and the fall of the Sith Empire, the [[Sith Triumvirate|Sith remnants]] [[Sith Civil War|fought each other]], [[First Jedi Purge|exterminated the remaining Jedi]] and waged a [[Dark Wars|secret war]] with the Republic, until the [[Battle of Malachor]] (3956-[[3951 BBY]]). [[3950 BBY|One year later]], the Sith Civil War ended, bringing the Old Sith Wars and the Sith Empire to an end. Some time later, a sole survivor on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] began the [[Rule of Two/Legends|rule of two]] by finding a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith Apprentice]].

In [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia]] of the Core World of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] sponsored an expanding fleet of three vessels&mdash;''[[Beneficent Tasia]]'', ''[[Constant]]'', and ''[[Mother Vima]]''. This fleet was led by the Republic explorer [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]] and would discover the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

From [[3970 BBY|3970]] &ndash; [[3670 BBY]], the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]] took place in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]. During that time, the [[Governor/Legends|Provisional Governor]] [[Myrial]] of [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]] seceded from the Republic and established a military regime throughout the Kanz Sector. During the conflict that followed, her military forces invaded planets that resisted her reign throughout the Kanz Sector, including [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]. She often enslaved their inhabitants, most notably the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdians]] of Lorrd.

The enslaved Lorrdians were forbidden by their masters from communicating with each other. As a result, they were forced to develop a system of subtle gestures, facial expressions, and body postures to talk to each other. This nonverbal form of communication would still be in use over four millennia later. After three centuries and the loss of over five billion lives, including those of some 500 million Lorrdians, the Kanz Disorders finally ended when Jedi/Republic efforts [[Liberation of Lorrd|toppled]] the regime in 3670 BBY.

In [[3700 BBY/Legends|3700 BBY]], the pioneer woman and [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] native [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] discovered the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], which spanned the entire north-south width of the galaxy. This allowed the Republic to expand past the Slice into the worlds of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rims]], and also led to the discovery of more hyperspace routes, including the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], thus starting the [[Second Expansion Wave]].

[[File:GalacticRepublicEmblem-Traced-TORkit.svg|thumb|left|250px|Symbol of the Republic during the Sith Empire's return.]]
In [[3681 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] returned to wage war against the Republic in the [[Great Galactic War]]. The War greatly weakened the Republic, culminating in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]]. The Treaty of Coruscant placed several major burdens on the Republic. A large economic depression began, slowing the rebuilding process and stalling efforts to restore peace. [[Treaty of Coruscant|The Treaty of Coruscant]] also forced the Republic to abandon many long-time allies, including the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]]. The Republic was forced to relinquish control of many planets to the Empire, such as [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. As a result of the Great Galactic War and its subsequent treaty, which left the Republic in an unfavorable position, many star systems began withdrawing from the Republic. The [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] took over [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], beginning the [[Separatist War]], while Alderaan seceded from the Republic altogether, beginning the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. The Republic was plagued with an insurmountable supply crisis and chaos in the streets of Coruscant, and the Senate was left paralyzed. Confused by the chaos, the insolvent Senate blamed the War and its current problems on the Jedi, sparking a feud with the Order that saw their departure from Coruscant and relocation to their ancestral homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. After the [[Great Galactic War]], after the signing of the [[treaty of Coruscant]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] began, lasting for 11 years before the tense peace collapsed around [[3642 BBY]], beginning the [[Galactic War]], which began to conclude around [[3637 BBY]] with a temporary truce between the Empire and the Republic during the re-emergeance of the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]] with Revan in lead. It finally ended in [[3636 BBY]] during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], in which the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire had to submit to the new power and were forced to pay huge amounts of resources. The Republic and the Sith Empire were [[War against Zakuul|liberated]] with the defeat of the [[Eternal Empire]] at the hands of the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] and their [[Eternal Alliance]]. Shortly after, tentions escalated again between the two side during the conflict on [[Iokath]], and later into an [[Third Galactic War|all out war]] after the Sith Empire's assault on the Jedi colony on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].

At an unspecified point in galactic history, the Sith Empire would eventually fall, with [[Darth Desolous]] having set up his [[Darth Desolous's army|own faction]] over a century after the Eternal Empire's invasion. In [[3000 BBY]], the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict]] ended with the final defeat of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and the introduction of the [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught]] into the Republic fleet.

===New Sith Wars===
{{Main|New Sith Wars}}

{{Quote|I will not let this Republic that has stood for a thousand years be split in two.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="EpisodeII" />}}
[[File:NewSithWars.jpg|thumb|The [[Ruusan campaign]] put an end to the Sith threat.]]
In [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]], the Republic once more faced the menace of the Sith with the fall of [[Darth Ruin/Legends|Darth Ruin]] and the rise of the [[New Sith]] Empire. This time, the Jedi took the forefront of the war against the revived order. The conflict with the reborn Sith Empire fluctuated over the course of hundreds of years until the [[Battle of Mizra]] in [[1466 BBY]], which saw one of the largest Sith victories in the entire war. The losses for the Republic were so catastrophic that a [[Republic Dark Age|dark age]] began, with widespread social unrest and economic collapse.

The Republic itself shrunk to a mere rump state surrounding the Core Worlds, Inner Colonies, and few other worlds outside it, with the Sith Empire encompassing virtually the rest of the entire galaxy. The Jedi took over absolute authority, ruling the remainder of the Republic directly. The Senate was bypassed, with sole governing power residing in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], while the Republic's armed forces were absorbed into the Jedi [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]].

After nearly five hundred years of continued war, the Army of Light had beat back the Sith to the planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. They were finally defeated in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] at the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], although almost all the forces of the Army of Light that were on Ruusan also perished. The lone Sith survivor, [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], subsequently initiated the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], meaning that at any given time there would only be one Sith Master and an apprentice. They continued this method over the next millennium, in secrecy, waiting patiently for the right moment to bring down the Jedi.

Following the battle, the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] was enacted by Chancellor [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]]. It returned power to the Senate, placed the Jedi under the authority of the Republic government, and disbanded the vast majority of its remaining military.

At long last, with war after war, peace and prosperity came to the Republic. Yet with it came a dangerous complacency. Vast armies and navies were downscaled, and the Republic came to rely on the Jedi more and more for the maintenance of civility. Despite a few isolated flashpoints&mdash;like the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] and the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]&mdash;full-scale military conflict remained a distant memory.

Nonetheless, remote planets theoretically under the jurisdiction of the Republic hardly could find the technology that was commonly available near the Core.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref> Feeling little interest for those planets, the Republic did not even chart them properly or classify all of their flora and fauna.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

===The decline of the Republic===
{{Quote|The Republic is not what it once was. The Senate is full of greedy, squabbling delegates. There is no interest in the common good.|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine|<ref name="EpisodeI">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
As the Republic grew more and more powerful, many of the bureaucrats and Senators that ran the government grew increasingly corrupt or complacent. The bureaucracy that had grown and festered over millennia choked any attempt at effective government. Furthermore, patron politics and personal agendas also hampered effective governing, and due to the increasing collusion of decadent governmental agents and politicians with favored groups, corporations like the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] grew in power and even formed their own militaries. It is likely, given the eventual result of this decline, that it was nurtured and accelerated (and perhaps even started) by the Sith during the centuries they spent in hiding after the Battle of Ruusan.

[[File:Republic6SpokedBenduSymbol-RotS.svg|thumb|left|150px|The Bendu-inspired symbol used during the later stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
During this time ([[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]) the Senator of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. His homeworld was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|under siege]] by the Trade Federation. Despite the full-scale invasion of the planet, the call to condemn the invasion was tied up in bureaucratic procedure. When Queen Amidala&mdash;the elected leader of the sovereign system of Naboo&mdash;spoke before the Senate, [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|calling for action]], she also called for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in the leadership of the Republic, under the persuasion of Palpatine, and Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was voted out of office. This led to the increasingly-popular Palpatine's election as the Supreme Chancellor of the Republic. 

Under Palpatine's administration, the Galactic Senate reaffirmed its commitment to cooperation and compromise, resulting in a brief period of relative peace and stability. However, dissident movements and secessionist sentiments emerged on various worlds, fueled by long-standing disputes that eventually escalated into the Separatist Crisis.<ref name="TCW CG" />

====Clone Wars====
{{Main|Clone Wars/Legends}}
{{Quote|There hasn't been a full-scale war since the formation of the Republic.|[[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]]|<ref name="EpisodeII" />}}
[[File:BF_Elite_Squadron_keyart.jpg|thumb|200px|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|under attack]] during the last phase of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
Traditionally, the Chancellor could only serve two four-year terms, but Palpatine stayed in office much longer, due to the prolonged [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], that [[Raxus Address/Legends|began]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].

The crisis occurred when several of the Republic's star systems and commercial organizations, fed up with the corruption and obliviousness to their issues and concerns in the Republic, united in order to separate from the Republic. This unified front became known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Tensions between the Republic and the Separatists eventually escalated into all-out war after a Jedi strike team came to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], which started the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]&mdash;and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], that began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
The Senate granted Palpatine emergency powers to deal with the Separatist Confederacy in a motion introduced by the Naboo representative [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. Palpatine's first move, widely supported at the time, was to create a vast army of clone warriors to serve as the Republic's fighting force against the Confederacy. The Republic had not previously needed an army since until then any small conflicts within the Republic could be solved by recourse to the peacekeeping Jedi, or to local navies and militias. However, the fact that the Confederacy had access to an enormous army of droid soldiers required the Republic to construct a more formal federal military in order to effectively fight.

However at least one enemy of the Republic managed to turn away from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] and ally itself with the galactic government, it was [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]], for rescuing their [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|leader's]] [[Rotta/Legends|son]], secretly held captive by the Separatists, thus the Republic had some advantage over the CIS during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]]. Along with their allegiance with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], the Republic was allowed the use of the Hutts' [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lanes]].

In the ensuing years, the Senate increasingly gave more power to Palpatine, who became the war's political Commander-in-Chief. Such actions were justified in the name of security, and eventually, Palpatine did not need the approval of the Senate for many of his actions. Since the Chancellor held the loyalties of a vast majority of supporters in the Senate, this was considered a perfectly reasonable way to increase the wartime government's efficiency. The citizens of the galaxy, who had long since lost faith in the corrupt and inefficient Republic itself, came to see Palpatine personally as their protector from the droid armies and their terrible commander, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

====The end of democracy====
{{Quote|So this is how liberty dies&hellip; with thunderous applause.|Padmé Amidala, to [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] following the [[Declaration of a New Order]]|audio=HowLibertyDies-ROTS.flac|<ref name="EpisodeIII">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
[[File:Declaration.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] replaces the Republic with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].]]
The tension between Chancellor Palpatine and the Jedi Order grew as the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Council]] became increasingly wary of the Chancellor's lust for greater power. As the Chancellor continued to increase his authority through a variety of emergency powers, the Council became ever more suspicious of Palpatine's intentions and ultimately disapproved of the Republic's gradual slide into autocracy, especially at the expense of the Senate&mdash;the only governmental body that the Order was legally obligated to serve.<ref name="EpisodeIII" />

With the help of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the Council discovered that Palpatine was actually the elusive Darth Sidious, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], and thus they conspired to [[Showdown on Coruscant|arrest]] the Republic's own head of state. The Jedi coup d'état ended in failure, however, when Palpatine killed all four of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], including [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], that tried to take him into custody. He then responded by declaring all Jedi as enemies of the Republic and won the Senate's support after portraying them as assassins bent on taking over the Republic. Through [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the Chancellor realized the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] long-awaited dream of the Jedi Order's destruction. Without warning, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] betrayed and murdered most of their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi officers]].<ref name="EpisodeIII" />

As the Clone Wars ended with the onset of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Palpatine addressed the Senate and [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] the rise of a [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], beginning with the Republic's immediate transformation into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Palpatine, who had been grotesquely disfigured during the attempt on his life, proclaimed himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], thus transforming the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|office]] of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] into what it had already become&mdash;an absolute dictatorship. Deluded by Palpatine's charm and skill, in conjunction with the effects of his [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] powers of persuasion, the majority of the Senate cheered him on loudly in approval. Soon afterward, industries were nationalized and the Republic was replaced by the authoritarian Empire, ruled by a megalomaniac autocrat.<ref name="EpisodeIII" />

[[File:Imperial_Emblem.svg|thumb|right|250px|The emblem of the Galactic Empire was a redesign of the Galactic Republic's symbol.]]
After more than 25,000 years, the Galactic Republic had ceased to exist. Only a shrunken, powerless [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] remained as the last symbol of the old galactic government. Prior to its [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]] [[0 BBY/Legends|two decades after]] the [[Imperial Era/Legends|rise of the Empire]], the Senate was nothing more than an ineffective advisory board that Palpatine tolerated until his reign was consolidated enough for him to rule without the stagnant bureaucracy. With the last remnant of the Old Republic destroyed by the very man whom they supported, the Senate's responsibilities were redirected to the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] and regional governors, all of whom were empowered to rule over their respective territories in the name of Emperor Palpatine.<ref name="EpisodeIII" /><ref name="EpisodeIV" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|We, the Beings of the Galaxy, in order to form a free union of planets, establish justice, provide for common peace and prosperity, and to secure liberty for all beings, do ordain and establish this New Republic. Let the stars sing! Let the planets shout! Let the Republic begin!|Excerpt from the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]]|<ref name="TTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Gavrisompellaeon.jpg|thumb|left|250px|After decades of Imperial oppression, the restoration of the Republic is officially recognized with the Empire's capitulation.]]
Barely a [[18 BBY/Legends|year]] into the reign of Emperor Palpatine, the Empire's precursor state became known as the "Old" Republic, mainly to emphasize the various excuses behind the Republic's fall and the creation of the Empire.<ref name="TTS" /> Though the Emperor focused much of his reign towards the gradual elimination of all remaining symbols that reminded the Imperial populace of their democratic past and heritage, the long history and cherished principles of the Old Republic were secretly held dear by a growing number of Imperial citizens that became disillusioned with the Empire due to the oppressive measures that Palpatine enacted to further strengthen his hold over the galaxy.<ref name="EpisodeIV" />

By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the Emperor's tyranny motivated several dissidents within the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] to [[Corellian Treaty|create]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], thus initiating the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> [[0 BBY/Legends|Two years later]] In response to the insurrection, the empire [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|abolished the senate]], which had officially left the rebellion as a separate galactic government from the empire. [[4 ABY/Legends|Four years later]], the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of both Emperor Palpatine and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] at the climactic [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] enabled the struggling Alliance to rebound from certain defeat while the Empire descended into [[Imperial Civil War|chaos and disorder]].<ref name="DE">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref>

In the following week, the Rebellion fought in the [[Bakura Incident]], immediately after that conflict the Alliance to Restore the Republic, was reorganized into the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], in the following month, the Alliance of Free Planets fought in the [[Nagai–Tof War|Nagai Tof War]] and immediately after that conflict, the new alliance, was reorganized into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]], the New Republic, [[Core Campaign|took]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|twice]], from the local Imperial faction, thus the restored Republic had officially claimed authority over the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the [[New Jedi Order]] was created in the [[Jedi Praxeum]], on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. After the [[Imperial Reunification]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Imperial Civil War had ended and unified the feuding Imperial factions into the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="VOTF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant signed a [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace treaty]] that ended the Galactic Civil War, fifteen years after the Battle of Endor.

The memory of the Old Republic, along with many of its ideals, was further carried on after the New Republic reorganized itself into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], due to the [[25 ABY/Legends|four]]-[[29 ABY/Legends|year]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] with the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]], who themselves had briefly [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|taken over]] the galaxy.<ref name="FHI">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]], at the aftermath of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|Lost Tribe War]], the Imperial Remnant, was reorganized into the [[Fel Empire]] and about a month later, the galaxy's Second Cold War had began, this time between the newly restored Galactic Empire and the Galactic Alliance, which would last for several decades.<ref name="Legacy0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> In [[127 ABY]], the truce, between the Imperials and the Alliance was broken, when the [[One Sith|Sith]] came out of hiding and [[Sith–Imperial War|declared war]] on the Galaxy, where the Fel Empire's influence increased significantly. In [[130 ABY]], the Fel Empire had finally taken over the Galaxy and the three-year war had come to a halt.

Their dominance was short-lived to a few months, when the resurrected Empire was overthrown by the Sith in a coup, in which they renamed it [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], which divided the previous government into the [[Empire-in-exile|Empire in exile]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], who began the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] and the [[Third Jedi Purge]]. In [[138 ABY]], Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire was taken down by an allegiance of the Galactic Alliance Remnant, the Empire-in-exile, and the fragmented New Jedi Order and created the new democratic government, known as the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]]. In [[139 ABY]], the GFT, would [[Darth Wredd's insurgency|defeat]] the Sith, but their secular alliances, continued to fight the GFT for well over a year, until their own surrender in [[140 ABY]]. Following the end of all these conflicts, the galaxy, had entered an era of peace and unity.

==Government and politics==
{{Quote|I love democracy. I love the Republic.|Palpatine|<ref name="EpisodeII" />}}
[[File:Galactic_Senate.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] [[Senate Building/Legends|building]], behind the [[Avenue of the Core Founders/Legends|Avenue of the Core Founders]].]]
The Republic began as a mutual protection and economic alliance among a number of planets in the galactic core. The Republic's greatest failing was its lack of formal organization. Much of its operation was based on nonbinding constitutional conventions, which were more often ignored and undermined by corrupt and power-hungry politicians than heeded. Coalition governments were common, with special interests defining the legislative agenda. The Senate, in the later years of the Republic, was so ineffectual that many politically connected corporations and informal blocs of ideologically like-minded planets could essentially do what they wanted; corrupt governmental bodies even made it possible for certain entities, such as the Trade Federation, to construct de facto sovereign and immense military forces.

However, the waning years of the Republic were a time of corruption and great social injustice. The Senate became divided between those who genuinely wished to uphold the values and ideals of the Republic and those who wished to further their own goals. After a series of weak and ineffectual Chancellors and a crisis involving the invasion of the planet Naboo by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] over a tariff passed in the Senate, the time had come for strong leadership to end the corruption.

Within the government, much of the bureaucracy was handled by the [[Galactic Republic General Ministry|General Ministry]]. Within this body were the Ministries of [[Ministry of State (Galactic Republic)|State]], [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]], [[Ministry of Commerce/Legends|Commerce]], [[Ministry of Defense|Defense]], [[Ministry of Education|Education]], [[Ministry of Finance (Galactic Republic)|Finance]], [[Ministry of Licenses and Permits|Licenses and Permits]], [[Ministry of Public Information|Public Information]], [[Ministry of Science (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Science]], [[Ministry of Security and Intelligence|Security and Intelligence]], [[Ministry of Internal Security|Internal Security]], and [[Ministry of Science and Education|Science and Education]].

===Legislative branch===
{{Quote|The Senate will decide your fate.''"''<br />''"''I ''am'' the Senate.|Mace Windu and Palpatine|<ref name="EpisodeIII" />}}
{{Main|Galactic Senate/Legends}}

Each member state (system governments) returned a representative (a senator) to a central legislative body (the Senate). Senators were the ambassadors of their homeworlds, and member worlds were able to maintain their government and society in accordance with local beliefs, customs, and traditions. There was a wide variety of different local governments along the political spectrum: from monarchies to republics to hive-like communes. In some systems, the senator was elected to that post; in others, the world government appointed the senator. Naboo's monarch appointed their senators, while the Alderaan Council of Elders elected their senator out of their own ranks (usually the heir to the Royal House of Organa, as the heir, was also the leader of the council).

[[File:Galacticsenate.png|thumb|left|200px|The [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]].]]
When the Republic's power and influence expanded, many new areas of the galaxy were incorporated into the Republic. A reorganization of senatorial representation occurred in the year 1000 BBY, during the Ruusan Reformation. The most common organization for these new territories was to group regions into sectors of approximately fifty inhabited worlds. Each sector was represented by a senatorial delegation. When the number of senators became too large, sectors were organized into roughly a thousand regions, each represented by one delegation to the Senate.

The Senate was headquartered in an enormous building containing many floating [[Repulsorpod/Legends|platforms]], each of which contained several senators. Each platform in the Senate represented a "sector" of the galaxy, with one senator from each planet in that sector. Some platforms represented individual worlds, others the powerful corporations and guilds such as the Trade Federation. Along with the senators, the leaders of the individual member planets also had the power to vote in the Senate and introduce legislation. The Senate followed such parliamentary rules as a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]], such as that introduced by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] which forced Chancellor Finis Valorum out of office in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

[[File:TF_Senate.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] addresses the Senate.]]
Senators received one vote in all matters&mdash;procedural and substantive. The Chancellor was elected from within the Senate. The assembly was in turn divided into individual committees, each specializing in specific fields of government administration, and which were responsible for creating legislation to be reviewed by the full assembly.

Although legislation passed by the Senate was binding to all member worlds, most of the everyday legislation followed by citizens of the Republic was created at the planetary, sector, or regional level. Therefore, the main functions of the Senate were to mediate disputes between members, provide for the common defense, and regulate inter-system trade.

===Executive branch===
{{Main|Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends}}

The members of the Senate would then elect a [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] from amongst their ranks who would serve as the Republic's head of government (and, by default, head of state) and chief diplomat.

The office was largely powerless in the last years of the Republic, especially after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], and the Chancellor served mainly as an officiator of parliamentary procedure and the first among equals in the Senate. However, it had the authority to call an [[Special session of Congress/Legends|Extraordinary Session]] of the Senate and could invoke "Chancellor's prerogative" in circumventing minor aspects of the Senate's parliamentary procedure. He also was the head of the [[Senatorial Council]].

It was still a very prestigious position, however, and the Chancellor had a grand office in both the Senate Rotunda's Chancellery and in the dome-like Senate Office Building in Galactic City. The Chancellor was properly addressed as "Your Excellency." The symbol of the office of the Chancellor, as well as the Galactic Senate as a whole, was a fanned spear. This cygnet was also emblazoned prominently on the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's podium]] in the center of the Senate Rotunda's Main Chamber. When in the Main Chamber, the Chancellor usually wore a [[Veda cloth/Legends|Veda cloth]] robe. The Chancellor was elected from among the senators who made up the Galactic Senate and served a term of office that lasted for four standard years. A Chancellor could legally serve only two consecutive four-year terms before he or she had to step down due to term limits.

The office became much more powerful during the term of Chancellor Palpatine, who was able to convince the Senate to grant him a range of "emergency" powers due to the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and then the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], including an unconstitutional extension of his term of office after [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] for the duration of the Separatist Crisis and authority as commander-in-chief of their [[Republic Military/Legends|new military]] during the Clone Wars. The Chancellor was given more direct power over administrative concerns, and he was allowed to overrule local planetary and sectoral governments. The [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]] allowed him to appoint military governors to every planet in the Republic, and the [[Security Act amendment]] gave him complete control over the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi Order]] and Republic military, stripping both the Jedi and the Senate of their previous oversight.

Eventually, Palpatine became a dictator and proclaimed himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the galaxy, thus abolishing the office of Chancellor and transforming the Galactic Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The position was not revived by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], which chose instead to call its chief executive the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]]. Ironically, Palpatine's thirteen years in office, added to his reign as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], forever tainted the once noble and prestigious position of Chancellor so much so that it was far too controversial to revive in the New Republic even though before Palpatine it had been a symbol of good in the Old Republic.

===Judicial branch===
{{Quote|He has control of the Senate and the Courts! He's too dangerous to be left alive!|Mace Windu on Palpatine|<ref name="EpisodeIII" />}}
{{Main|Supreme Court/Legends}}
{{Main|Regional Court}}
The Court consisted of twelve justices (each addressed as "Your Honor"); one of them was the [[Chief Justice]] who headed both the Court and the judicial branch. The Supreme Chancellor nominated judges to the Court and the senate had to approve the nominations, while the nomination of the Chief Justice had to be confirmed by the judges of the Court.<ref name="TCW CG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

===Relationship with the Jedi Order===
{{Main|Jedi Order/Legends}}
{{Quote|The Republic keeps the Jedi in check. It maintains control and imposes order across thousands of worlds. But if the Republic falls, a score of new interstellar governments and galactic organizations will rise. It is far easier to manipulate and control a single enemy than twenty. That it is why we must seek out radical separatist groups, identify the ones that have the potential to become true threats, then encourage them to strike before they are ready. We must exploit them, playing them off against the Republic. We must let our enemies weaken one another while we stay hidden and grow strong. One day the Republic will fall and the Jedi will be wiped out. But it will not happen until we are ready to seize that power for ourselves.|Darth Bane|<ref name="Rule of Two" />}}
[[File:JediTemple-TZBSB.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], headquarters of the Order on Coruscant.]]
When the formation of the Galactic Republic occurred in [[25,053 BBY]],<ref name="TORE" /> the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had already existed for [[25,783 BBY|several hundred years]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="T1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> Within a century since the Republic's conception, the Order pledged its support for the new government, and thus became formally answerable to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. But despite the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] allegiance to the Senate, the Order had always enjoyed a great degree of autonomy to act as they saw fit, especially regarding internal Jedi affairs. Nevertheless, for thousands of years the Jedi Order's members consistently served the Senate in a variety of capacities&mdash;whether as special emissaries, peacekeepers, or warriors.<ref name="JediVsSith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref><ref name="CW20">{{CW|20}}</ref>

But as the Republic gradually expanded its sphere of influence over the known galaxy, the unprecedented level of peace and prosperity also led to a virtually irreversible trend in corruption, decadence, and stagnation, especially amongst the [[Senator/Legends|elected officials]] of the Senate. Yet throughout all of that time, the Jedi Order maintained its traditions and principles, often acting as a beacon of honor and integrity within a society that was becoming increasingly amoral and unjust. The Republic government's decline into greed and complacency was not lost on the Jedi either; many within the Order loathed the thought of being accountable to an ineffectual system that was too large and disorganized to effectively counter the growing list of problems that plagued the Republic and its citizens.<ref name="EpisodeI" /><ref name="EpisodeII" />

Throughout its long history, the Jedi were forced to intervene on "behalf" of the Senate by diffusing internal and external threats to the Republic's stability. During the [[New Sith Wars]], the Order was even forced to take a more "hands-on" approach to government itself, mainly by commandeering the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|executive office]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] due to the Senate's inability to counter the danger that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] posed to Republic primacy throughout the galaxy; it would take an entire [[1000 BBY/Legends|millennium]] before the Jedi could risk leaving the government to its own devices once more.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="DBPOD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

After the Sith were presumably destroyed in the conclusion of the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], the Jedi Order was able to enjoy a thousand years of keeping the peace throughout the Republic without having to worry about another galactic-scale war. Though the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|demilitarization]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic armed forces]] placed an even greater burden on the Order, the Jedi handled their responsibilities well enough to ensure that the Republic's stability was not threatened by the sudden lack of a strong military force.<ref name="EpisodeI" /><ref name="EpisodeII" />

[[File:Clone_Army_Charge.jpg|thumb|right|250px|When necessary, the Jedi defend the Republic on behalf of the Galactic Senate.]]
As the Republic reached the twilight of its existence, relations between the Jedi Order and the galactic government on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had grown strained more than ever. The Senate was filled by a large majority of self-serving delegates who cared nothing for the troubles of their constituents, effectively reducing the few honest members to an ineffective collection of senators with little hope of restoring honesty to the august body. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] grew ever more disdainful of the Senate to the point where they believed that no politician could ever be trusted. Likewise, the Senate began losing faith in their ancient protectors. As the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] worsened to the point where the galaxy was on the verge of being split in half, many senators came to doubt the Order's ability to safeguard the Republic or its government.<ref name="EpisodeII" />

Despite the evident animosity between the Order and the legislature, the Senate wasted no time in commissioning the Jedi as [[Jedi General/Legends|officers]] in the newly formed [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Throughout the conflict with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], the Jedi Order acted once more as the Senate's armed instrument by leading millions of [[Clone trooper/Legends|soldiers]] and amassing countless victories on various battlefields throughout the galaxy. But even as the Jedi championed the Republic cause and led its army to ultimate victory over the Separatists, the relationship between the Order and the Senate was nowhere near any improvement. The tension reached its climax when the Jedi Council contemplated seizing control of the Senate, an action they would have only had to take had they removed Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from office by force. Hence, the Council had evidently lost all faith in the Senate's ability to preserve the Republic's stability in a time of crisis.<ref name="EpisodeIII" />

After the Council [[Showdown on Coruscant|failed to arrest]] Palpatine, the public facade of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious, the Senate did not hesitate to rid itself of its Jedi guardians by doing nothing as the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] commenced with [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]]. With the Jedi virtually neutralized, and with the Senate under the control of the Sith, Palpatine easily reorganized the Republic into the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with himself as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]]. Throughout Palpatine's [[Declaration of a New Order|Declaration of a]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the vast majority of the Senate applauded the extremely radical amendments that officially brought an end to a Republic that had existed for over 25,000 years. At the same time, the Jedi were being hunted down and annihilated by the Empire while the Senate made no attempt to intercede on behalf of the organization that had protected them since the founding of the Republic. For thousands of years, the Jedi Order stayed true to their allegiance to the Galactic Senate, even in the worst of times when the legislature reached the zenith of its corruption, only to be betrayed and abandoned by the elected officials that they were sworn to serve and protect.<ref name="EpisodeIII" />

When the Senate was reformed after the fall of the Empire and the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the undeniable advantages that the Jedi contributed to the Old Republic convinced the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Senate]] to promote the restoration of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="DE" /> Throughout most of its history, the Jedi Order personified the nobility of the Galactic Republic; the mere existence of the Order enabled the Republic to exist as the pinnacle of galactic civilization in spite of an incredibly corrupt and inefficient legislature.<ref name="JediVsSith" /> Without the Jedi Order, the Republic would have collapsed under the Senate's dead weight long before its time&mdash;a fact that was proven when the near elimination of the Jedi allowed Darth Sidious to transform the Republic into the Empire.<ref name="EpisodeIII" />

[[File:Chancellors_Office.png|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi Council and the Supreme Chancellor, leader of the Galactic Senate, work together for the good of the Republic.]]
To better improve the chances of preserving the fledgling New Republic, the Senate recognized the necessity of ensuring the Order's full reconstitution. Even after the New Republic reorganized itself into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], a government that more closely resembled the Old Republic, the Jedi gradually resumed their former role as peacekeepers and emissaries for the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]]. By [[44 ABY]], the relationship between the Jedi and the government was strikingly similar to their former association with the Old Republic's Senate, which culminated with another [[Plan Delta|Jedi coup d'état]] against the government&mdash;one that actually succeeded in the overthrow of a tyrannical [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|head of state]] and with the approval of the Senate.<ref name="Convinction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

==Economy==
{{Main|Galactic economy}}
The Galactic Republic's influence on the galactic economy was linked to its regulatory powers, production of Republic [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|dataries]], and authorization of relevant bodies.

At the heart of the galactic economy was the planetary trade. The Interplanetary trade could support a local economy, but, in many cases, the high levels of economic interaction and the massive scale of exchange required for an advanced society could only be funded by interplanetary exports. While some planets maintained their own shipping fleets, most relied on large freight firms, such as [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]], or independent freight haulers to carry their goods along major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].

The Corporate Sector was first formed in [[490 BBY]] to free the Republic lawmakers and the Corporate moneymakers from their differences. In the last millennia of the Galactic Republic, commercial interests began to form guilds to increase their influence on relevant legislation and achieve greater efficiency. While most of these guilds, like the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], and the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], collapsed after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a number of surviving members flocked to the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].

Thousands of currencies were used across the galaxy. The Galactic Republic's dataries were perhaps the most widespread form of currency. Because of the Republic's exceptional membership, dataries were accepted on all but the most remote planets. From its inception, the credit was backed by the immense wealth of the planet [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. During the Clone Wars, the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|IGBC]] backed the currencies of both sides.

Working beings were required to pay taxes, which were collected by the [[Republic Tax Collection Agency/Legends|Republic Tax Collection Agency]]. In the later years of the Galactic Republic, a [[transit tax]] of 15% was levied to raise revenue for the government.

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|The Republic is civilization. It's the only one we have.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="ROTS Novel" />}}
[[File:JavyarsCantina-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The stage of a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].]]
The Galactic Republic had a very diverse culture. Member worlds were able to maintain their own culture in accordance with local beliefs, customs, and traditions. There was a wide variety of different cultures within the Republic: from religious communities like the Jedi to hive-like communes.

The Republic had a liberal policy towards arts also. The dominant aesthetic style of Galactic Republic-era was opulence and ornamentation.

Although [[Humanocentrism]] was technically outlawed by the [[Rights of Sentience]] clause of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]], it still very much existed throughout the life of the Galactic Republic. Human-led organizations such as [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] enslaved entire nonhuman races, while planetary governments such as that of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] reserved the best sections of the world for Humans while forcing non-humans into ghettos. The majority of slaves in the galaxy were non-humans. At the time the Clone Wars broke out, there were still lawsuits pending about pro-Human bias in the Republic government.

==Military==
{{Main|Republic Military/Legends}}

{{Quote|I will create a Grand Army of the Republic to counter the increasing threats of the Separatists.|Palpatine|<ref name="EpisodeII" />}}
[[File:Republicfleetkotor.jpg|thumb|left|300px|A Republic fleet during the [[Jedi Civil War]].]]
The Republic's earliest days were not peaceful ones, since, as the Republic expanded across the galaxy, it encountered many warlike species. The Republic realized the need for an [[Republic Army|army]] and [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] to keep the peace. The Republic's military forces would serve throughout many conflicts, including the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the various conflicts of the [[Old Sith Wars]], and the [[New Sith Wars]] as well as the absolutely ravenous [[Great Galactic War]].

After the [[Ruusan campaign]], the Republic decommissioned much of its military, retaining a small force only for security purposes. This force would later become known as the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]]. This was to display the Republic's peaceful ideals, as the Republic used Jedi Knights as "keepers of the peace."

Several trade corporations, such as the Trade Federation, the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], and the Commerce Guild, kept their own security forces in order to protect their profits, but they often abused this power, such as in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Individual sectors also maintained their own security forces, such as Naboo's [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] or [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and these were sometimes used to combat small threats. However there was no centralized command, and the members of the late-period Republic loathed change.

[[File:Republic_Assault.png|thumb|250px|The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] leading the charge on Geonosis.]]
The Clone Wars changed all this. The Republic had no standing military to combat the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and thus a [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] was proposed, which was strongly opposed by many of the Republic's pacifist leaders such as Padmé Amidala of Naboo, who feared the possibility of going to war. Supporters of the Military Creation Act included [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].

However, a clone army had already been created in secret on the remote planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], ten years earlier. When it became clear the Confederacy had no intention of negotiating with the Republic, the Republic adopted this army, along with [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT/c]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut|A5]] and [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|A6 Juggernauts]], [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyers]], and [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]], among numerous other craft and vehicles, in a combined force known as the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The army was unleashed in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] against the Separatist droid forces. These loyal troops would serve in many battles throughout the conflict and on worlds such as [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]], [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], and even [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Ever since the unveiling of the Republic's secret clone army, the clones found themselves to be at the center of a great deal of controversy throughout the Clone Wars. While virtually all of the clones professed their unwavering loyalty to the Republic and their desire to fight and die for it, ultimately clones were either pitied by some sympathizing individuals or despised and not trusted by others. While Jedi such as [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] sympathized with the clones and developed an affinity for them, others like [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] immensely distrusted the clones and felt that non-clone combatants made better soldiers on the battlefield. Regardless of the perceived "slave army" status and all attempts to treat the clones humanely, sympathy and an increasing reliance on the clones was a grievous error on the Republic's part as Order 66 and the rise of the Empire would prove. Under the Galactic Republic, there were those who cared for the clones and how they felt. Under the Galactic Empire, they would never be perceived as anything more than what they always were: a product and a disposable army of droid-like human soldiers.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine transformed the Galactic Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The loyal [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the Grand Army of the Republic would become the dreaded [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], while the regulars and starships were segmented into the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], respectively. However, due to the fact that the clones aged at twice the rate of ordinary humans, regular human recruits would finally be implemented into the stormtrooper ranks - much to the quiet dismay of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] clones. While the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] remained evenly divided between clones and birth-born soldiers, cloning had been virtually phased out as the remnants of the fallen Empire were forced to rely completely on ordinary humans and non-humans alike - thus phasing out the last remnants of the Galactic Republic's clone army.

==Astrography==
The Galactic Republic was composed of a significant portion of the known galaxy, stretching from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to at least partially, the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], though it was widely believed that the government held little power in the outlying regions, and preferred to focus its attention on the Core Worlds and Colonies. The exact number of planets in the Republic fluctuated, ranging from three million worlds to just over a thousand, but in 21 BBY it was a little less than 1.3 million planets, with some 10-40,000 systems controlled by the Separatists.<ref name="Shatterpoint novel">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> The Senate was in control of thousands of star systems while more than two hundred systems had defected to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref>[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in Star Wars II: "About two hundred" [systems have joined the Rebellion]</ref> by the time Palpatine finally ended the Republic.

The capital of the Galactic Republic was Coruscant, a planet considered to be the cultural and economic center of the galaxy, despite being located outside of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. To signify its importance in galactic affairs, Coruscant was given coordinates 0-0-0 in the standard galactic coordinate system.

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'' established the Republic to be extant for 25,000 years,<ref name="DEsource">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> based on the [[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]] saying that "the Jedi, as is well known, have served as guardians of peace and justice throughout the Galaxy for over 25,000 years"<ref name="DEend">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]]</ref> and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] line in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] that the Jedi had been "the guardians of peace and justice in the Old Republic" "for over a thousand generations."<ref name="EpisodeIV" /> Furthermore, the Republic appeared in the Legends [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]], which is set in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="GAOTS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''</ref> However, in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], Palpatine mentioned the Republic had "stood for a thousand years."<ref name="EpisodeII" /> This would seem to conflict with both the [[Star Wars Legends#Official levels of canon|C-canon]] Legends history and the [[Star Wars Legends#Official levels of canon|G-canon]] internal continuity within the films. In [[Star Wars Legends#Official levels of canon|T-canon]], the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the TV show ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' made a reference to a fallen "Old Republic", in which the Jedi Order was also present, predating the Republic of the Prequel-era.<ref name="The Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> Prior that, in Legends, the Ruusan Reformation&mdash;in which the Republic is reorganized following the already-established [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|defeat of the Sith]] a thousand years prior to the films&mdash;was invented by subsequent writers to give an alternate explanation on Palpatine's line, thus bringing all these sources into relative harmony.<ref name="calendar">{{Blog|danwallace|3|Star Wars Calendars}}</ref> Palpatine could also be considering the [[Republic Dark Age]] as a temporary disbandment, the Republic essentially reforming after the Ruusan Reformation in 1000 BBY.<ref name="NEC" />

During Cannes Film Festival in 2005, franchise creator [[George Lucas]] when presenting the film and explaining the themes of democracy being allowed by the people to become a dictatorship implied that the overall state of the Galactic Republic in the prequel trilogy, especially the leadup to the Galactic Empire in particular, was based on that of the [[Wikipedia:Roman Republic|Roman Republic]] under [[Wikipedia:Julius Caesar|Julius Caesar]], the [[Wikipedia:First French Republic|revolutionary France]] under [[Wikipedia:Napoleon Bonaparte|Napoleon Bonaparte]], and the [[Wikipedia:Weimar Republic|Weimar Republic of Germany]] under [[Wikipedia:Adolf Hitler|Adolf Hitler]].<ref name="'Sith' invites Bush Comparisons">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbsnews.com/news/sith-invites-bush-comparisons/2|text=''Revenge of the Sith'' invites Bush Comparisons, page 2|work=CBSNews.com|archivedate=20210227045528}}</ref><ref name="USA Today">{{WebCite|url=http://usatoday30.usatoday.com/life/movies/news/2005-05-15-cannes-lucas_x.htm|text=Lucas: 'Star Wars' isn't Iraq wars|work=USATODAY.com|archivedate=20210227022457}}</ref>
